fields.original_text: When Java encounters a for loop, it first executes the initialization statement (e.g., initializing the counter variable to zero). Then it evaluates the loop condition; if true, it executes the loop body. After the body, it performs the increment step, then re-evaluates the condition. This repeats until the condition is false, at which point control moves outside the loop.
